name: Aldrich Arena Farmers' Market - Winter
tagline: Costa Produce Farm – Saint Paul Farmers' Market
description: Aldrich Arena Farmers' Market - Winter gathers local farms and food producers in 290 5th St E, MN. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
